windy-api-key.title: Windy Webcams API Key
windy-api-key.description: Get a free key at https://api.windy.com/keys

x-openmapx-setup.urlLabel: Get a Windy Webcams API key
steps: Sign in to (or create) a free Windy account, then open api.windy.com/keys.
Create a new API key and select the Webcams API; the free tier requires no payment.
Copy the key (it may take a few minutes to propagate); it is sent as the 'x-windy-api-key' header.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Free tier returns only low-resolution images, image URLs expire after 10 minutes, and the listing offset is capped (~1000).

us-nps-api-key.title: NPS API Key
us-nps-api-key.description: Get a free key at https://developer.nps.gov/signup/

steps: Open nps.gov/subjects/developer/get-started.htm and fill out the 'Get Started' sign-up form.
Submit the form; an email with your personalized 40-character API key is sent to you.
Copy the key (passed on each request as ?api_key=...).
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Self-service form on nps.gov; the key arrives by email (developer portal is developer.nps.gov). Delivery is usually near-instant.

se-trafikverket-api-key.title: Trafikverket API Key
se-trafikverket-api-key.description: Free account key for Sweden's Trafikverket traffic-information API.

steps: Create an account and verify the email address.
Accept the API licence and create an API key.
Paste the key used as the XML request authentication key.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: The Camera object is available through the Trafikverket traffic-information API.

no-npra-username.title: NPRA DATEX Username
no-npra-username.description: Username issued for the Norwegian Public Roads Administration DATEX node.

steps: Order access to the NPRA DATEX node.
Save the issued username and password here.
The CCTV site-table request uses HTTP Basic authentication.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Credentials are required even though the underlying data is openly licensed.

au-nsw-webcam-api-key.title: Transport for NSW API Key
au-nsw-webcam-api-key.description: Free API key for the Live Traffic NSW camera GeoJSON feed.

x-openmapx-setup.urlLabel: Register for NSW open-data API access
steps: Create a Transport for NSW Open Data account.
Subscribe to the Live Traffic API product and create an API key.
Paste the x-api-key value here.

tw-tdx-webcam-client-id.title: Taiwan TDX Client ID
tw-tdx-webcam-client-id.description: OAuth client ID for Taiwan's Transport Data eXchange.

steps: Create a TDX member account.
Create an application and copy its Client ID and Client Secret.
Save both values; OpenMapX exchanges them for a short-lived bearer token.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: CCTV image URLs require an authenticated TDX membership.

us-ga-511-api-key.title: Georgia 511 API Key
us-ga-511-api-key.description: Register at https://511ga.org/my511/register. Read by the data-manager POI-ingest process from the environment, NOT from this vault — set INTEGRATION_WEBCAM_US_GA_511_API_KEY instead; saving it here alone will not reach the consumer.

steps: Create a free My511 account at 511ga.org/my511/register (or log in).
Open the Developer Resources page (Developers → Documentation) at 511ga.org/developers/doc.
Request a Developer API key from your account; it is issued automatically.
Copy the key (sent as the 'key' query parameter).
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Georgia 511 runs the IBI Group / Castle Rock 511 platform. Self-service. Rate limit: 10 calls per 60 seconds.

us-fl-511-api-key.title: Florida 511 API Key
us-fl-511-api-key.description: Register at https://fl511.com/my511/register. Read by the data-manager POI-ingest process from the environment, NOT from this vault — set INTEGRATION_WEBCAM_US_FL_511_API_KEY instead; saving it here alone will not reach the consumer.

steps: FL511 runs FDOT's SunGuide platform, not the IBI 511 platform, so there is no self-service developer key page.
Email FDOT/SunGuide to request programmatic access to the data feeds powering FL511.
After approval, use the credentials and feed host they provision.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Florida does not use the IBI self-service flow; API/data access is by request through FDOT rather than an automated web form.

email.subject: FL511 / SunGuide traffic data feed access request
email.body:
Hello,

I am building an application that would use Florida 511 (FL511) traffic camera and event data, and would like to request programmatic access to the FDOT SunGuide data feeds that power FL511.

Could you let me know the process to obtain access credentials, any usage terms, and which datasets (cameras, events, message signs, etc.) are available?

Thank you.

x-openmapx-setup.urlLabel: Request access to PennDOT data feeds
steps: Submit the PennDOT Data Feed Request Form to request the RCRS_Event_Data service.
Create a PDAuth account at gis.penndot.pa.gov/pdauth/login.
Email penndotdata@pa.gov with your PDAuth username and reason for access.
After approval, use your PDAuth credentials (HTTP Basic Auth) to access the feed.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Not the IBI511 self-service flow. The public 511PA site has no developer page; access is granted by request through PennDOT's open-data program.

email.subject: Request for access to PennDOT RCRS Event Data feed
email.body:
Hello,

I would like to request access to the PennDOT RCRS_Event_Data web service. My PDAuth username is: <your PDAuth username>.

Reason for access: <brief description of your intended use>.

Thank you.
